summary: Professional Diversity Network (IPDN) filed an 8-K reporting a stock purchase agreement to acquire 3.2% of AI Geometric Ltd for $1.36M. Consideration is 2 million IPDN common shares issued under Regulation S offshore exemption, approved by the board. No premium or deal advisors named. The transaction uses stock consideration (IPDN shares) and is structured as a minority stake purchase in a UK entity with a May 15, 2026 expected close. As a small non-controlling stake, the deal lacks typical risk-arb mechanics. Watch for Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635 compliance and any future strategic moves.
